title: Deploy decision models with llama.cpp on Amazon SageMaker AI
summary: Learn how to deploy decision models with llama.cpp on Amazon SageMaker AI. This technical how-to serves OpenAI-compatible chat completions with the AWS Deep Learning Container for llama.cpp, then extends the runtime with SemIf to return probabilities over declared options on CPU
